# Nucleo game font v2 CANDIDATE: 5x11 cell, advance 6 (20 chars per 120 px line). Hand-drawn ('.'=off '#'=on).
# Rows 0-10: 0-1 capital accents, 2-8 capitals/ascenders (7 rows), 4-8 x-height (5 rows),
# 1-2 lowercase accents (row 3 stays empty so they never fuse with the letter; umlaut dots on row 2), 9-10 descenders. Same glyph set/order as font.txt but 11 rows per glyph.
# Original work, no third-party font data.
